strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_break_retest_engulfing_long
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute scalp version, mark the first 9:30-9:35 candle high/low, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break the level, form a fair value gap, retest back into that FVG, and have the retest candle get engulfed before entering long.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop under the lowest point of the move into the fair value gap with one tick of breathing room, and take a fixed 3:1 target. No micromanagement after entry.

variants.timeframe_note: Identify the opening range on the 5-minute chart; confirm on the 1-minute chart
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for FVG retest and engulfing candle confirmation
variants.transcript_quote: we're going to wait for a retest of the fair value gap... then we wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed... for our takerit, we are 그냥

strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_limit_entry_long
strategies.entry_summary: On the day-trading version, mark the first 15-minute candle high/low, switch to the 5-minute chart, wait for the level to break and form a fair value gap, then place a passive limit order directly on the FVG as soon as price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle in the fair value gap pattern, just under that first candle, and target a fixed 2:1 return. The trade is then left alone without micromanagement.

variants.variant_label: 15-minute first candle + 5-minute confirmation + passive limit + 2:1 target
variants.timeframe_note: Identify the opening range on the 15-minute chart; confirm on the 5-minute chart
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: set a limit order on the FVG instead of waiting for a retest/engulfing candle
variants.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG... we are going to target a fixed 2:1 return

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: a scalp entry using FVG retest + engulfing confirmation, and a day-trading entry using a passive limit order on the FVG. They are separate because their entry logic and target/management differ.
